definitions.explanation: A woman on her wedding day or who has recently been married.

examples.japanese: {花嫁|はなよめ}が{美|うつく}しい{ドレス}を{着|き}ていた。
examples.english: The bride was wearing a beautiful dress.

examples.japanese: {花嫁|はなよめ}{姿|すがた}の{彼女|かのじょ}は{輝|かがや}いていた。
examples.english: She was radiant in her bridal appearance.

examples.japanese: {花嫁|はなよめ}{行列|ぎょうれつ}が{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎた。

notes:
USAGE: {花嫁|はなよめ} combines {花|はな} (flower) and {嫁|よめ} (bride/wife). It specifically refers to a woman in the context of her wedding.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {花嫁|はなよめ}になる (to become a bride)
- {花嫁|はなよめ}{姿|すがた} (bridal appearance)
- {花嫁|はなよめ}{衣装|いしょう} (bridal attire)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {花嫁|はなよめ}{修業|しゅぎょう} (bridal training - learning domestic skills)
- {花嫁|はなよめ}{道具|どうぐ} (bride's household items/trousseau)
- {花嫁|はなよめ}{行列|ぎょうれつ} (bridal procession)

CONTRAST:
- {花嫁|はなよめ} - bride
- {花婿|はなむこ} - groom
